title: Sequoia Heritage Cayman Feeder IV
archetype: Conditional Logic Deadlock + Multi-Signer Race Condition
author: minh.nguyen

outcome.summary: A circular Step 4 lock on joint-signer W-8BEN-E accounts slipped UAT sign-off and the initial close by 9 days, fixed by the v2 joint-signer schema.

incident: On the night of 2025-04-14 (23:02 ICT), the day before planned UAT sign-off, QA found that joint-signer non-US entity LPs could not finish Step 4 (Tax Certifications). If Signer 1 selected Active NFFE on W-8BEN-E Part I, line 5 while Co-Signer 2 was reviewing Part XXIX (Substantial U.S. Owners of Passive NFFE), each side waited on the other and DocuSign envelope generation stayed blocked. A forced unlock then failed envelope pre-flight on a duplicated Chapter 4 anchor tag. 7 of the 31 initial-close LPs (about US$138M of commitments) were exposed, and UAT sign-off and the initial close each slipped 9 days.
rootCause: The v1 schema let every Joint Signatory edit the Chapter 4 election in a private draft, evaluated Part XXIX against each signer's draft, and locked Step 4 while any collaborator had a section open, which made a circular wait. It also cloned one DocuSign anchor onto every signer. The sub agreement (Section 4.3(b), Annex B) actually defines one Designated Tax Signatory and N-1 attesters.
resolution: Minh Nguyen shipped cayman_fatca_joint_signer_v2.json, a state-isolation patch. It binds the Chapter 4 and CRS elections to the PRIMARY_TAX_COLLABORATOR role (the Annex B Designated Tax Signatory) and gives co-signers a read-only view plus their own attestation. It evaluates Part XXIX from the committed primary election, and it replaces the Step 4 exclusive lock with a completion rule. Separate DocuSign anchors (\ch4_primary_sig\ for the primary, \cosigner_N_attest\ for co-signers) fixed envelope generation.
reusableRules: Chapter 4 elections belong to exactly one role on joint accounts: map the sub agreement's Designated Tax Signatory to PRIMARY_TAX_COLLABORATOR, and give co-signers a read-only view plus their own attestation.
Evaluate conditional logic (visibleWhen / requiredWhen) against committed state, never against a collaborator's draft.
Never lock a whole step on 'someone has a section open'; gate completion on committed data plus per-signer attestations, and refresh other views on commit.
Use one DocuSign anchor per recipient per signature location; only the Designated Tax Signatory signs W-8BEN-E Part XXX.
At kickoff, encode the sub agreement's joint-signatory clause and annex as roles in the form spec.
Test joint accounts with concurrent sessions in both signer orders, and never prefill the FATCA Chapter 4 status from the CRS classification.

artifacts.title: Cayman FATCA joint-signer schema v2 (W-8BEN-E + CRS)
artifacts.description: State-isolated Step 4 schema. The Designated Tax Signatory owns Chapter 4 and CRS elections, rules evaluate on committed state, Part XXIX is keyed on the committed election, co-signers attest per Annex B, and DocuSign anchors are split per recipient.
